p2v.copy_cpu_topo.description: Whether to copy the physical machine's complete CPU topology to the guest.

p2v.cpu_model.description: CPU model for the guest (e.g., IvyBridge).

p2v.cpu_vendor.description: CPU vendor for the guest (e.g., Intel, AMD).

p2v.disks.description: List of block device names to convert (e.g., sda, sdb).

p2v.fail_command.description: Post-conversion command to run on failure.

p2v.identity.description: URL pointing to an SSH private key (e.g., file:///path/to/key or https://...).

p2v.interfaces.description: List of network interfaces to convert.

p2v.memory.description: Memory size for the guest with unit (e.g., 1024M, 2G).

p2v.name.description: The name of the guest VM to create.

p2v.network_map.description: List of network mappings in format interface:target (e.g., em1:ovirtmgmt).

p2v.output_connection.description: Libvirt URI for the output connection.

p2v.output_misc.description: List of miscellaneous output options in format OPTION=VALUE.

p2v.output_type.description: Output mode for virt-v2v (e.g., libvirt, local).

p2v.port.description: The SSH port number on the conversion server.

p2v.post_command.description: Post-conversion command to run on success.

p2v.removable.description: List of removable media devices to convert.

p2v.server.description: The hostname or IP address of the conversion server.

p2v.use_sudo.description: Whether to use sudo on the conversion server to gain root privileges.

p2v.username.description: The SSH username to log in with on the conversion server.

p2v.vcpu_cores.description: Number of vCPU cores for the guest (ignored if copy_cpu_topo is true).
